headline: Intelligent Science and Technology · Large Language Models
bioMarkdown: I am a master's student in **Intelligent Science and Technology** at **Southeast University**, China. I received my bachelor's education in **Computer Science and Technology** from **Xinjiang University**. My research interests focus on **Large Language Models**, particularly **Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)**, **State Space Models (SSMs)**, and efficient neural architectures. I am interested in improving the efficiency, scalability, and architectural design of modern language models.
